supersedes.reason: Version 7 initialized the full GPU stack and collected twenty complete mixed-probe episodes, but every four-branch group had a constant reward. Prime correctly stopped after ten consecutive empty batches before an optimizer step.

scope.purpose: Prove that the 4B LoRA Stage C path completes one exact-snapshot ReDCO update with a preregistered signal-rich integration fixture, auditable trainer metrics, and compact adapter retention.

signal_acquisition.fixture: eight-way planted needle with rewarding digit 1

v7_diagnostic_pilot.interpretation: V7 is used only as an explicitly reported diagnostic pilot to choose a reliable integration fixture. V8 is frozen before observing any new model output and makes no learning-quality claim.

behavior_action_policy.representation: one model token from the complete behavior-policy support
behavior_action_policy.invalid_action_semantics: Any token whose exact decoded text is not an allowed digit is retained without repair and receives the deterministic failure reward.
behavior_action_policy.same_distribution_contract: All four branches use the same checkpoint, prompt, temperature, top-p, tool state, maximum length, and unrestricted token support; only structural seed and cache salt vary.

evidence_and_storage_contract.effective_subset_semantics: Every retained branch group must remain complete and have nonconstant rewards. One to ten complete collection attempts may appear in the all-traces artifact.

hardware.spot_policy: reject the resource if provisioning identifies it as spot or preemptible
prohibited: a second simultaneous Stage C pod

resource_policy.stop_if_v2_lifecycle_error_recurs: ValueError: clean Stage C permits one collected group per snapshot

mandatory: all frozen source hashes match locally and remotely
one to ten complete ten-trace collection attempts are serialized under policy version zero
the effective subset contains at least one complete four-branch group with nonconstant branch rewards
each effective branch records exactly one sampled token, temperature 2.0, a distinct structural seed, and a distinct cache salt
invalid displayed actions, if any, are retained with null canonical action and their true deterministic failure reward
every target is committed before action sampling
all effective branch records report exact sliced/full reward equivalence
the trainer metrics file contains exactly one finite positive optimizer gradient norm
a non-empty filesystem-broadcast LoRA adapter is saved
no gathered full-model safetensors checkpoint is produced
decision_rule.failure: sync all artifacts, emit a signed structured failure, terminate compute, and do not start a learning arm
